blurb: Peake Private Charters offers private charter boat experiences on the South River and Chesapeake, using a 27 foot Chaparral SSX and a 25 foot Sea Ray SDX. Guests can anchor in secluded coves, explore hidden Chesapeake gems, or enjoy sunrise/sunset cruises. Water sports including tubing, wakeboarding, and waterskiing are available, all captained by a USCG certified captain. Customer satisfaction and safety are emphasized.
